description: This file defines the Layout model class for the OpenCart admin system, managing CRUD operations for layout entities in the database, including routes and modules associated with layouts.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Represents the Layout model responsible for managing layout records in the database, including CRUD operations, routes, and modules.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Creates a new layout record in the database and adds associated routes and modules based on the provided data.

methods.name: editLayout
methods.description: Updates an existing layout record, replacing routes and modules with new ones from the provided data.

methods.name: deleteLayout
methods.description: Deletes a layout record and all associated routes, modules, and references in related category, product, information, article, and topic models.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves a specific layout record by its ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of layout records, optionally filtered and sorted based on provided criteria.

methods.name: getTotalLayouts
methods.description: Returns the total number of layout records.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Adds a new route record associated with a layout.

methods.name: deleteRoutes
methods.description: Deletes all route records linked to a given layout.

methods.name: deleteRoutesByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes route records for a specific layout ID.

methods.name: deleteRoutesByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes route records associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Retrieves all route records for a specific layout.

methods.name: getRoutesByStoreId
methods.description: Retrieves all route records associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Adds a new module record to a layout.

methods.name: deleteModules
methods.description: Removes all module records for a given layout.

methods.name: deleteModulesByCode
methods.description: Deletes modules matching a specific code or with similar codes.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Retrieves all modules associated with a specific layout.
